problem_title: Any reason to skip DML on empty lists?
caption:
Any reason to skip DML on empty lists?

🔴 The Problem: In parts of my code I have DML statements with an if around to only do the DML if the list is not empty: Couldn't I just write? Or would I provoke errors or needlessly consumed limits by doing that?

✅ The Fix: Good question, I've never considered it before... i've just assumed the platform will play fair and I'm pleased to find it does!
